run_go_env_export: run env.py with no arguments to print export statements for the hermetic Go toolchain environment variables
run_go_env_wrap_command: run env.py followed by a command like go version to execute it with the hermetic Go toolchain environment
run_go_env_wrap_python: run env.py with python as the first argument to execute the current Python interpreter with the Go toolchain environment
review_bootstrap_prepare_go_environ: review the bootstrap module prepare_go_environ function that returns a dictionary of Go toolchain environment variables
review_bootstrap_find_executable: review the bootstrap module find_executable function that locates an executable within the Go workspace directory
